name: PARKWD
recent: PARKWD 于 2025 年 9 月完成可放弃附加股发行，并附送凭单，新股和凭单已于 9 月 10 日上市。随后在 9 月 12 日出现多名董事及大股东权益变动的申报。公司于 11 月 20 日公布了截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
notable: 完成附加股发行并附送凭单，新股和凭单于 2025 年 9 月 10 日上市。
多名董事及大股东于 2025 年 9 月 12 日申报权益变动。
risks: 附加股发行涉及 313,707,585 股新股及 39,213,441 张凭单，可能对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。

PARKWD - RENOUNCEABLE RIGHTS ISSUE OF 313,707,585 NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN PARKWD ("PARKWD SHARES") ("RIGHTS SHARES") TOGETHER WITH 39,213,441 FREE DETACHABLE WARRANTS ("WARRANTS") ON THE BASIS OF 2 RIGHTS SHARES FOR EVERY 1 EXISTING PARKWD SHARE HELD AND 1 WARRANT FOR EVERY 8 RIGHTS SHARES SUBSCRIBED

recent_en: PARKWD completed a renounceable rights issue with free warrants in September 2025, with the new shares and warrants listed on 10 September. This was followed by filings of changes in director and substantial shareholder interests on 12 September. The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2025 on 20 November.
notable_en: Completed a rights issue with free warrants, with the new shares and warrants listed on 10 September 2025.
Several directors and substantial shareholders filed changes in their interests on 12 September 2025.
risks_en: The rights issue involved 313,707,585 new shares and 39,213,441 warrants, which may dilute existing shareholders' interests.
